build_Feature2Pyramid: build a Feature2Pyramid neck module connecting a ViT backbone to decoder heads with configurable rescales
create_Feature2Pyramid_with_custom_resca: create a Feature2Pyramid instance with custom rescales list [4, 2, 1, 0.5] and SyncBN normalization
run_Feature2Pyramid_forward: run the forward pass of Feature2Pyramid on a tuple of input feature maps to get pyramid outputs
review_Feature2Pyramid_init: review the Feature2Pyramid __init__ method to understand how upsample, identity, and downsample ops are built per rescale
refactor_Feature2Pyramid_forward: refactor the Feature2Pyramid forward method to support dynamic rescale lists beyond the default four operations
